assertion: Twelve perspective controls cross perspective origin, preserve-3d/flat and an overflow grouping property. Nested Z translations expose flattening and projection order.

browser.reason: Reviewed projection and overlap against Chrome and Firefox; preserve-3d survives only without a flattening overflow property. WebKit captures omit this perspective effect and are retained as diagnostics. Chrome differences follow polygon edges.
